name: CORE by Clare Smyth
address: 92 Kensington Park Road, Notting Hill, London, W11 2PN
dinnerNote: Core Seasons tasting menu, 7 courses (Core Classics £265)

menus.name: Core Classics tasting menu
menus.note: Clare Smyth's best-known dishes, including the 'Potato and roe' and the 'Core apple'

dressCode: Strictly no sportswear, such as tracksuit bottoms or hoodies; smart trainers are fine. Guests turned away for the dress code are charged the cancellation fee.
children: Young guests are welcome if they eat from the regular menu, but small children and babies can't be accommodated.
bookingOpens: Online through OpenTable, or by phone. The whole table eats from the same tasting menu or the à la carte.
cancellation: Cancelling with less than 72 hours' notice, reducing numbers or not turning up costs £175 per person.
groups: The Chef's Table, beside the kitchen, needs a £2,500 non-refundable deposit and can be moved up to 14 days before. For private events, email info@claresmyth.com.
